name: Tarsons Products Ltd
title: Tarsons Products Ltd - 543399 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Capex cycle ending: FY27 depreciation peaks at INR105-110 crores and maintenance capex ~INR20 crores, but Q4 standalone export fell 13.4% and gross margin slipped to ~58.5% on raw-material spikes.

capex.quote: There is no additional capex plan. Whatever capex is pending and whatever CWIP is there, we are just completing that.

triggers.label: Gross margin Q4 ~68% (standalone 58.5%)
triggers.quote: Currently, in Q4, we have shown 68% kind of gross margin, but we are gradually increasing the prices also.

triggers.label: Export revenue down 13.4% in Q4
triggers.quote: a decline of 13.4% in the export business during Q4 FY '26

triggers.label: Domestic growth ~12% in Q4
triggers.quote: delivering approximately 12% year-on-year growth in Q4 FY'26

guidance.quote: the depreciation amount will be in the range of INR105 crores to INR110 crores. That will be the peak for us.
We expect the entire capex program to be fully commissioned during the first half of the current financial year.
not want debt to increase more than 2x our EBITDA

red_flags.label: Standalone gross margin 58.5% in Q4
red_flags.quote: Gross margin for the standalone business in Q4 FY '26 stood at 58.5%

red_flags.label: Export decline and FY27 PAT 'moderate'
red_flags.quote: For FY'27 PAT is likely to remain at a relatively moderate level.

evasions.quote: I would not be able to answer that clearly because at this point of time, we have a significant spike in raw materials
we are still in a wait -and-watch mode
